title_as_printed: Results of calorimetric measurements of molar enthalpies of solution of oxygen, rare gases, and C1 to C4 n-alkanes at three different temperatures
pressure_note: total pressure p in the calorimetric system during a series of experiments (gas saturated with water vapour; ~1.06e5 Pa, i.e. ambient atmospheric pressure)

value.what: molar enthalpy of solution of the gas in water at infinite dilution, mean of N injections of the series; printed column is the NEGATIVE of the enthalpy (header -<A_sol H_m>), so value = -1 x printed (positive printed numbers are exothermic, negative enthalpy)

uncertainty.what: reproducibility, estimated standard deviation of the individual enthalpy values within the series

skip_rows.reason: gas label rows (O2, He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, CH4, C2H6, C3H8, C4H10)

extra_unmapped: N (number of injections in the series)
10^6 n_g mol (amount of gas injected per experiment)
notes: Temperature T is printed only on the first row of each sub-block; here carried forward to every row of the sub-block (not printed on those rows). Gases He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe and n-butane are outside the gas scope; their blocks are kept with gas codes he, ne, ar, kr, xe, n-c4h10. Printed pressure is the pressure in the calorimeter, not a gas partial pressure. Flow calorimeter: gas is injected into flowing de-aerated water; concentrations are very low (infinite dilution assumed by authors).
mapping_fix: label_row indices for Ne..C4H10 corrected by +1 on 2026-10-02 (lint: rows are label rows of the CSV); before the fix the last row of each preceding gas block was dropped and the next-gas label row was read as data
